method: ORCHESTRATOR read every English key against `git show 624a673:<path>` (18/18 verbatim), adjudicated EXECUTOR changes and three contextual-review rounds against that source and in-file term precedent; risk flags not used (whole-section slice).

advisory.note: 'Tales of Maj'Eyal' rendered as the official short name 'ToME 4'; not a semantic error, left unchanged.

preflight: tools/contextual_anchor_preflight.py whole-section form (commit 7085a98), PREFLIGHT_VERIFIED for ctx-01/02/03

adjudicated_findings.observation: “He smirks”表示带有得意、轻蔑或讥讽意味地笑；译为“假惺惺的微笑”改成了虚伪作态，人物神态含义错误。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'He smirks' = smug/contemptuous smile, not hypocrisy; 假惺惺 misstates the Master's demeanour (pre-existing line, in scope).

adjudicated_findings.observation: 术语表规定 Maj'Eyal=“马基埃亚尔”，译文作“马基·埃亚尔”，与冻结术语不一致。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: Maj'Eyal: terminology table 马基埃亚尔; this batch's ogre passage already uses 马基埃亚尔 — unify within batch. ORCHESTRATOR adds: 'Keeper(s) of Reality' rendered 时空(的)守护者 in lines 1-2 but 现实至高守护者 for 'Grand Keeper of Reality' in the last line; in-file precedent 现实守护者 ×2 — unify to 现实守护者.

adjudicated_findings.observation: “Reknor ... has been overrun by orcs”表示堡垒已被兽人攻占，译为“受到了兽人的侵扰”仅表示遭侵扰，改变了堡垒当前状态。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'overrun by orcs' = taken over; 受到侵扰 understates the fortress state. ORCHESTRATOR adds: 'Away from all those orcs....' continues the adventure-life sentence; 你最好离那些兽人们远点 turns it into advice.

adjudicated_findings.observation: “venture into the old and wild places of the world”译为“进入那些古迹”，把世界各处古老荒野缩窄为古迹，遗漏“wild places”的目标范围。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'old and wild places of the world' narrowed to 古迹; other sections in this batch already render it 古老而荒野的地方 — unify.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 在“one way trip”和“before the end”的语境中，“go in a blaze of glory”指以壮烈方式迎来结局；译文“轰轰烈烈地闯进去”误成进入地下城，“在终点前”也把“the end”误成地理终点，改变了直至死亡的关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'go in a blaze of glory' = meet a glorious end; 闯进去 reads 'go in' as entering. 'before the end' = before death/the end of the run, not a geographic endpoint.

adjudicated_findings.observation: “at such a pivotal time for your people”这一关键时势限定在译文中完全遗漏，丢失了两面夹击之所以格外致命的背景关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'at such a pivotal time for your people' omitted; restores why a two-front assault is devastating.

adjudicated_findings.observation: “lately you have grown restless”表示最近开始躁动不安；译文“但最后你还是变得有些不安分”改成最终发生，时间关系错误。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'lately you have grown restless' = recently; 最后 misstates the timing.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 专名“Tales of Maj'Eyal”被替换为“ToME 4”，既未保留原游戏名，也未采用术语表规定的 Maj'Eyal=“马基埃亚尔”。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'Tales of Maj'Eyal' rendered as 'ToME 4': the same game's official short name; the sibling intro-tutorial-combat-stats source itself says 'Welcome to ToME 4', and there is no in-file precedent for 马基埃亚尔传说. Not a semantic error; left unchanged.

adjudicated_findings.observation: source 中“to be found in ancient ruins”只修饰 treasures；target 的“古老废墟中有关……的传说”把地点挂到“传说”上，并将龙、黄金也纳入该地点，关系错置。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'the treasures to be found in ancient ruins' — ruins modify treasures only; pre-existing line, in scope.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 第二段将回指 Orc Prides 的 Prides 译成“兽人”，与冻结术语 Orc Pride=兽人部落及同文前句“兽人部落”冲突，丢失了部落组织指称。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'the front line against the Prides' — Prides = Orc Prides = 兽人部落 (terminology, and the same passage's first paragraph).

executor_cycle0_summary: 25 lines across 14 sections, all host-verified against 624a673 before contextual review (see HOST-VERIFICATION note in task record); key items: Point Zero 'permitted chronomancy to exist', Ogre 'fix them yourself'/'never wronged', Yeek Way link+way of life, sunwall 'defend the outpost', Spellhunt/High Sun Paladin/Wayist/vermin term alignment.
